name: Eleonora Bertsa-Fuchs
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: I am clear and down-to-earth, and love providing you with actionable tools so that you can make changes in your day to day life based on what we discuss in our sessions. ​ My work is sex positive and trauma-informed. I always aim to make you feel safe, seen and valued, and to validate and affirm your identities and life experiences. You are the expert in yourself - so I am committed to taking the time and care to listen to your perspectives and lived experiences.

name: Eva Birch
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a registered counsellor, who offers psychotherapeutic and psychoanalytic treatment for issues such as anxiety, depression, stress, work and relationship problems. I have experience, in particular working with clients with psychosocial disability and clients resolving creative blocks and building a creative practice. In psychoanalytic treatment, the aim is to land on elements of the unconscious, which often contradict the rational and conscious narratives the patient uses to “understand” their problems.

name: Fiona McLauchlan
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Fiona provides counselling for the emotional aftermath of trauma, relationship harm, family violence, grief, life transitions, and other painful life experiences , while welcoming and respectfully holding your spiritual, faith-based worldview and values. Fiona provides a warm, grounded space to make sense of what you’ve lived through rebuild self-trust strengthen boundaries, and move forward with greater clarity and choice. When something painful, confusing or destabilising has happened, it can continue to affect how safe you feel how you see yourself, and how you move through relationships, with yourself and others.
